text.card: A red giant 3,329 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.99 solar masses and 20.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,733 K at its surface.
